% Files of the document that give a .4ht's name in \ProvidesFile, read
% with the primitive \input from a package of the document beside it,
% with hyperref. As in the PDF, each file's text is in the page, and
% tex4ht reads no .4ht of those names.
% - test-ownprim.sty reads test-ownprim/glossary.tex, named like
%   glossary.4ht, with \input.
% - test-ownprim.sty reads test-ownprim/index.tex, named like index.4ht,
%   with \@@input. index.4ht defines \printindex, which the PDF does not
%   have, so the page shows that it was read: a sentence the PDF does not
%   have.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{test-ownprim}
\begin{document}
Glossary: \ownprimglossary\par
Index: \ownprimindex
\ifdefined\printindex\par Index read for the web.\fi
\end{document}
